quarterly_data.signal: BizLink's Q2 2026 investor deck adds the business mix the call did not give: HPC was 42% of Q2 2026 sales (34% in 2Q25, 46% in 1Q26) and grew +67% YoY and +1% QoQ; SPE (capital equipment) was 14% (13% in 2Q25 and 1Q26), +52% YoY and +28% QoQ; others 44% (53% in 2Q25, 41% in 1Q26), +13% YoY and +18% QoQ. By end market, IT DataComm was 42% of Q2 sales, Industrial 35%, Electrical Appliances 12% and Automotive 10%. The company says the Q2 recovery extended across HPC, SPE and its broader portfolio.
